svg.title: From model to collider shapes
svg.desc: An OBJ model is voxelized externally. The tool fills a voxel grid, fits enabled sphere, cuboid and capsule candidates to the largest remaining component, selects the best exact score and removes covered voxels. It repeats until a stopping condition, restores source coordinates, and exposes Unity collider parameters.

g.text: A Python / PyTorch tool for approximating geometry with simple shapes.
No components, component threshold, or model limit
Restore source scale and offset. Convert each fitted shape to Unity parameters.
holosinc/primitivefitting · fit.py / models.py / unity.py · Schematic shapes
